newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle sales light, steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle sales light, steady - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested, but few sales steady, USDA said. Buyer inquiry fairly good. Seller interest light. Weekly total 83,700.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1275 lbs - pen
Sales Confirmed - 600 Last Week - 1,000 Last Year - 3,800
